name: io.github.gjlmotea/slicewise-for-bambu-studio-mcp
title: Slicewise
description: Pre-print checks for Bambu Studio: GUI-faithful CLI slicing, override audit, printability.

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_MODEL_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folders the model tools may read from, joined with the platform path delimiter (':' on macOS and Linux, ';' on Windows). Model reads are refused when unset

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for sliced and composed 3MF output; also readable by the model tools. Writing tools are refused when unset

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_STUDIO_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Bambu Studio executable; resolved from the default install location when unset

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Bambu Studio data folder holding system and user presets; resolved per platform when unset

environmentVariables.name: THINGIVERSE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Thingiverse app token; only the Thingiverse part of model search needs it
